definitions.explanation: Describes a state where one's attention is diverted and concentration is broken.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うるさくて→うるさい：00763_urusai⟧{気|き}が{散|ち}る。
examples.english: It's too noisy around here and I can't focus.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気|き}が{散|ち}る⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けた→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: I put my phone away because it was distracting me.

examples.japanese: {気|き}が{散|ち}って⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}できない→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm too distracted to concentrate on studying.

examples.japanese: ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気|き}が{散|ち}る⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{消|け}して→消す：00528_kesu⟧⟦くれない→くれる：00724_kureru⟧？
examples.english: The TV being on is distracting, could you turn it off?

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していて→する：00392_suru⟧{気|き}が{散|ち}る。⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{終|お}わって→終わる：00567_owaru⟧ほしい。
examples.english: There's construction outside the window and it's distracting. I wish they'd finish soon.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (attention) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{散|ち}る→散る：02075_chiru⟧ (to scatter). Literally 'one's attention scatters.'

TRANSITIVE COUNTERPART: ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散|ち}らす→散らす：02288_chirasu⟧ (to distract someone or oneself)
- ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散|ち}らす→散らす：02288_chirasu⟧ (to distract oneself with games)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}→集中：03212_shuuchuu⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (can't concentrate)
- ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{散漫|さんまん}→散漫：09237_sanman⟧ (attention is scattered - more formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {気|き}が{散|ち}る: passive distraction (something pulls your attention away)
- ⟦{気|き}を{取|と}られる→気を取られる：30584_kiwotorareru⟧: attention is captured by one particular thing
